title: Interplanetary Box
tagline: A decentralized service to upload and share content with anyone
description: This project combines a web interface that allows the user to upload files to IPFS in a safe way. The user will be able to create its own decentralized profile with the content they want to share with the world, and even sell some of this content. It will also allow the users to share its content in an easy and private way with other users.
how_its_made:
It uses Self.ID from Ceramic Network for user authentication. It uses Tableland for data storage and fast access and query of the data, and pinata as the gateway to upload the files to IPFS.

In a future stage it will use Polygon to deploy the NFT contracts to handle the market portion that will allow the users to sell the files they upload.
